items.name: system1-fraud-interceptor-demo
items.description: Demo de un interceptor de fraude simulado que compara en paralelo un modelo Sistema 1 (Jev, TypeSafe AI) con un LLM (Gemini) sobre transacciones sintéticas: velocidad, costo por llamada y decisiones. Proyecto personal de experimentación, no es un benchmark.

items.name: jev-access-day
items.description: A learning scaffold for TypeSafe AI's System One models: eval harness plus a measured, plain-language comparison of the Jev decision model vs an LLM stand-in on 24 real operational decisions. All numbers reproducible from committed run files.

items.name: paper-radar-jev
items.description: An automated research paper radar that fetches the latest papers from arXiv, evaluates their relevance to a configurable research profile using TypeSafe AI, and ranks them by relevance score. Designed for personalized, daily literature discovery across different research domains.

items.name: jev-fact-checker
items.description: Uses Typesafe AI Jev to Provide A Tweet Fact Checker

items.name: jev-policy-engine
items.description: Jev Policy Engine is the first universal Policy-as-Code SDK built for TypeSafe AI's Jev System One model. It allows RevOps, DevOps, and Security teams to define strict, deterministic AI governance rules in YAML, and execute them at high speed.

items.name: jev-map-sandbox
items.description: Jev (TypeSafe AI の System One モデル) を地図に使ってみる実験場。音声指示で地理院地図Vector のレイヤーを重要度分類する。

items.name: jev-orderby-bench
items.description: Does ORDER BY over a Jev probability put rows in a defensible order? Independent ranking, calibration and invariant measurements of TypeSafe AI's Jev: passes six pre-registered gates on 360 labeled rows, fails four of six on graded product relevance.

items.name: Typesafe_chess_eval
items.description: An evaluation of typesafe AI chess. As it turns out, the AI isn't doing really well even though chess is not a particularly open-ended game. Still, it's only a prototype and this probably wasn't optimzied for games.

items.name: GameSearch
items.description: Typesafe AI library for two players perfect knowledge games in java.

items.name: jev-spam-lab
items.description: CLI for evaluating Microsoft Outlook email with TypeSafe AI’s Jev model.

items.name: jev-technical-term
items.description: YouTubeの解説動画やZoomのセミナーを聞きながら、出てきた技術用語のひとこと解説をリアルタイム表示するローカルツール(判定AIは TypeSafe AI の Jev)

items.name: llm-cost-optimizer-jev
items.description: An intelligent routing layer powered by TypeSafe AI's System One model Jev that sits in front of multiple LLM providers, analyzes each incoming request’s complexity, routes it to the cheapest model capable of handling it at acceptable quality, and continuously validates that routing decisions are correct.

items.name: transcript-scorecard
items.description: ACME live support-call scoring demo with TypeSafe AI, Effect, SQLite, React, Vite, and Turborepo

items.name: hermes-plugin-jev
items.description: Jev (TypeSafe AI) System One decision engine plugin for Hermes Agent, backed by Agnes AI Flash.

items.name: hundred-faces
items.description: A wall of a hundred invented people who react while you type, on TypeSafe AI's Jev

items.name: home-assistant-typesafe
items.description: Home Assistant conversation integration powered by the Jev / TypeSafe AI API for fast, structured intent routing and device control

items.name: chess-with-jev-
items.description: An empirical experiment fusing TypeSafe AI's non-autoregressive Jev model (System 1) with a high-performance 0x88 alpha-beta search engine (System 2). Includes live Chrome extension tracking, trust window fusion, and real-time telemetry, capable of defeating 1825 ELO bots.
